data.animaCaption: Peeking back past the parted dark-green velvet fitting curtain with her sheer lilac wrap slipping off one shoulder, she asks for help with the tiny rear clasps of her lavender lace corset. Warm vertical mirror lights softly illuminate her flushed cheeks and bare back in the glass.
data.promptProse: Composed through the narrow gap of a heavy dark-green velvet fitting-room curtain pulled slightly open in the foreground, Ayachi Nene stands angled before a tall vanity mirror. She wears an intricate lavender French-lace bustier paired with black garter straps, black thighhighs, and a sheer chiffon wrap sliding loosely off her arms; turning back over her bare shoulder with deeply flushed cheeks and parted lips, she reaches behind her waist toward the unfastened rear hooks while the mirror softly reflects her posture under warm vertical dressing-room sconces.
data.story: 试衣间的深绿绒布帘被悄悄拉开一道窄缝。宁宁红着耳根背对三面镜回头看你，轻纱罩衫滑落臂弯，声音压得像羽毛一样轻——「这件后面的小扣子太细了，我怎么都够不到……就、就帮我扣一下，不许乱看哦。」
